summary: Iter-20 — Validated NextCapOS Phase-1 External File Source Mirror (Composio) feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_external_sources.py (~6s) covering (1) GET supported list returns exactly the 6 toolkits {googledrive, onedrive, sharepoint, dropbox, box, zohoworkdrive}, (2) POST googledrive creates a pending row with non-null entity_id 'nextcapos-{uid}-{lid}' + redirect_url + composio_connections mirror row, (3) POST with bogus source_kind 'megaupload' → 422 (Literal mismatch), (4) /poll on pending returns {status:'pending'} and swallows the upstream null connected_id without crashing, (5) /sync on pending returns 400 with detail mentioning 'pending' + 'active', (6) DELETE soft-deletes (deleted_at set, no longer in GET), (7) Wipe-on-close: created fresh listing → connected onedrive source → inserted fake listing_staged_files row with source.sid → PATCH status=closed → both the staged file AND the source doc end up with deleted_at set (verified via direct Mongo read), (8) RBAC: buyer Alex POST → 403, (9) RBAC: fresh editor collab via invite→register fast-path POST → 200. Frontend: Playwright on the preview URL validated (a) ExternalSources panel renders inside the dataroom expander with data-testid 'external-sources-{lid}', (b) picker has 7 options (placeholder + 6 services), (c) Connect button initially disabled, enables after picking a service, (d) clicking Connect POSTs to backend, opens window.open with the Composio redirect URL (verified via stub), and a new pending row appears with data-testid 'source-{sid}' + status pill 'pending', (e) pending row exposes source-reopen-{sid} + source-disconnect-{sid} BUT NOT source-sync-{sid} (correctly gated), (f) clicking source-disconnect-{sid} (with confirm auto-accept) fires DELETE and the row disappears, (g) view-as-principal mode: with data-view-as-principal=true on the listing card, the panel still renders the source rows but suppresses source-connect, source-picker, source-disconnect-*, source-sync-*, source-reopen-* — exactly matching the existing collaborator-suppression pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3712-3726 _composio_action_execute correctly raises HTTPException(502) on upstream >=400 and threads upstream text into detail — good. Note: it relies on httpx.AsyncClient timeout=60s; consider that for a 100-file sync this could stack to multiple minutes per sync call — acceptable given the 100-file cap at line 3946.

server.py:3749-3762 init flow catches *any* Exception (broad) from the Composio call and falls back to a placeholder redirect URL. This is the documented dev-env behaviour but means a real upstream auth failure (401 from Composio) is silently swallowed with only a logger.warning. For production, consider raising on 401/403 (auth misconfig) vs 5xx (transient) so sellers don't get a fake 'pending' row that will never flip.

server.py:3783-3792 inserts into composio_connections in addition to listing_external_sources. The duplicate write keeps the legacy /api/composio/connections endpoint working but creates a dual-source-of-truth risk: poll/disconnect updates BOTH collections in sync (good), but if a future write touches only one the lists diverge. Consider deriving /composio/connections from listing_external_sources via aggregation instead of writing twice.

server.py:3917 sync endpoint returns HTTPException(400, f"Source is {src['status']}, not active. Complete OAuth first.") — the f-string interpolates the actual status value (e.g. 'pending', 'failed'), matching the user-requested error message exactly for pending state.
server.py:3946 cap of 100 files per sync prevents pulling a 10k-file drive in one shot — good guardrail. The errors list is truncated to the first 3 in last_error which is fine for the panel display.

server.py:4053-4078 _wipe_listing_external_sources iterates sources sequentially with per-source HTTP DELETE to Composio. For a listing with 6 connected sources this is 6 sequential ~10s timeouts in the worst case (60s total before listings.update_one returns). Consider asyncio.gather for parallel revoke, with the same swallow-all-errors semantics.
server.py:1625 status-flip guard correctly checks `prev.get('status') != 'closed' and body.status == 'closed'` so re-PATCHing a closed listing doesn't re-trigger the wipe (idempotent — good).

server.py:3805 GET strips redirect_url from the listing-wide view, so collaborators/buyers can't see OAuth links they shouldn't use. Good. But the POST response on the SAME endpoint *does* return redirect_url for the seller — only the initial creator gets the link, exactly as designed.
ExternalSources.jsx:142-144 unconnected filter excludes connections in 'failed' status, allowing the seller to reconnect a previously failed source without disconnecting first. Reasonable.
ExternalSources.jsx:67-71 cleanup interval clears all pollRefs on unmount — good, no leak.

ExternalSources.jsx:140 useEffect dep array uses `data.sources.map(s => s.status).join(',')` which is a stable serialisation but recomputes the entire dep string on every render. Fine for small N (<= 6) but a useMemo would be cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flows: panel render, picker options, connect-disabled gating, connect→pending row, button gating per status, disconnect removes row, view-as-principal suppresses actions)

View-as-principal toggle is the button[title*='principal'] inside listing-card-{lid}; flipping it sets card[data-view-as-principal=true] and the panel re-renders with all action buttons hidden (only source-{sid} status rows remain). data-testids confirmed in panel: external-sources-{lid}, source-picker, source-folder-id, source-connect, source-{sid}, source-status-{sid}, source-reopen-{sid}, source-disconnect-{sid}, source-sync-{sid} (only when status=active). source-badge-{file_id} for the staged-file 'via {kind}' pill was not exercised (no active source possible without real OAuth).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The mirror-first architecture is clean: one Pydantic Literal enum drives both the picker options and the schema validation, the wipe hook fires exactly once on draft→closed transitions, RBAC is enforced via the existing _listing_for_edit_or_404 helper (same as upload/PATCH), and the per-row UI gating reuses the same viewAsPrincipal prop pattern already proven for the upload form + collaborator panel. Composio upstream returning null connected_id in dev is handled gracefully via fallback placeholder URL + null-guard in /poll (line 3825), so the entire API surface is exercisable without a real OAuth handshake.
